import { Panel } from './Panel';
import { t } from '../services/i18n';
import {
  getPinnedWebcams,
  getActiveWebcams,
  unpinWebcam,
  toggleWebcam,
  onPinnedChange,
} from '../services/webcams/pinned-store';

const MAX_SLOTS = 4;
const PLAYER_FALLBACK = 'https://webcams.windy.com/webcams/public/embed/player';

function buildPlayerUrl(webcamId: string, playerUrl?: string): string {
  if (playerUrl) return playerUrl;
  return `${PLAYER_FALLBACK}/${encodeURIComponent(webcamId)}/day`;
}

export class PinnedWebcamsPanel extends Panel {
  private unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor() {
    super({ id: 'windy-webcams', title: t('panels.windyWebcams'), className: 'panel-wide', closable: true });
    this.unsubscribe = onPinnedChange(() => this.render());
    this.render();
  }

  private render(): void {
    // #6557: build all nodes first, then one atomic write through the
    // sanctioned helper â€” replaces the manual clear + progressive appendChild.
    this.content.className = 'panel-content pinned-webcams-content';

    const active = getActiveWebcams();
    const allPinned = getPinnedWebcams();

    const grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'pinned-webcams-grid';

    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_SLOTS; i++) {
      const slot = document.createElement('div');
      slot.className = 'pinned-webcam-slot';

      const cam = active[i];
      if (cam) {
        const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
        iframe.className = 'pinned-webcam-iframe';
        iframe.src = buildPlayerUrl(cam.webcamId, cam.playerUrl);
        iframe.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups');
        iframe.setAttribute('frameborder', '0');
        iframe.title = cam.title || cam.webcamId;
        iframe.allow = 'autoplay; encrypted-media';
        iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
        iframe.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
        slot.appendChild(iframe);

        const labelBar = document.createElement('div');
        labelBar.className = 'pinned-webcam-label';

        const titleSpan = document.createElement('span');
        titleSpan.className = 'pinned-webcam-title';
        titleSpan.textContent = cam.title || cam.webcamId;
        labelBar.appendChild(titleSpan);

        const toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
        toggleBtn.className = 'pinned-webcam-toggle';
        toggleBtn.title = 'Hide stream';
        toggleBtn.textContent = '\u23F8';
        toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleWebcam(cam.webcamId));
        labelBar.appendChild(toggleBtn);

        const unpinBtn = document.createElement('button');
        unpinBtn.className = 'pinned-webcam-unpin';
        unpinBtn.title = 'Unpin';
        unpinBtn.textContent = '\u2716';
        unpinBtn.addEventListener('click', () => unpinWebcam(cam.webcamId));
        labelBar.appendChild(unpinBtn);

        slot.appendChild(labelBar);
      } else {
        slot.classList.add('pinned-webcam-slot--empty');
        const placeholder = document.createElement('div');
        placeholder.className = 'pinned-webcam-placeholder';
        placeholder.textContent = t('components.pinnedWebcams.pinFromMap') || 'Pin a webcam from the map';
        slot.appendChild(placeholder);
      }

      grid.appendChild(slot);
    }

    const children: HTMLElement[] = [grid];

    if (allPinned.length > MAX_SLOTS) {
      const listSection = document.createElement('div');
      listSection.className = 'pinned-webcams-list';

      const listHeader = document.createElement('div');
      listHeader.className = 'pinned-webcams-list-header';
      listHeader.textContent = `Pinned (${allPinned.length})`;
      listSection.appendChild(listHeader);

      allPinned.forEach(cam => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'pinned-webcam-row';
        if (cam.active) row.classList.add('pinned-webcam-row--active');

        const name = document.createElement('span');
        name.className = 'pinned-webcam-row-name';
        name.textContent = cam.title || cam.webcamId;
        row.appendChild(name);

        const country = document.createElement('span');
        country.className = 'pinned-webcam-row-country';
        country.textContent = cam.country;
        row.appendChild(country);

        const toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
        toggleBtn.className = 'pinned-webcam-row-toggle';
        toggleBtn.textContent = cam.active ? 'ON' : 'OFF';
        toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleWebcam(cam.webcamId));
        row.appendChild(toggleBtn);

        const removeBtn = document.createElement('button');
        removeBtn.className = 'pinned-webcam-row-remove';
        removeBtn.textContent = '\u2716';
        removeBtn.title = 'Unpin';
        removeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => unpinWebcam(cam.webcamId));
        row.appendChild(removeBtn);

        listSection.appendChild(row);
      });
      children.push(listSection);
    }

    // #6557: one atomic write â€” grid plus the optional overflow list.
    this.setContentNodes(...children);
  }

  public refresh(): void {
    this.render();
  }

  public destroy(): void {
    this.unsubscribe?.();
    this.unsubscribe = null;
    this.content.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(f => {
      f.src = 'about:blank';
      f.remove();
    });
    super.destroy();
  }
}

import { getRpcBaseUrl } from '@/services/rpc-client';
import type { WebcamEntry, WebcamCluster, ListWebcamsResponse, GetWebcamImageResponse } from '@/generated/client/worldmonitor/webcam/v1/service_client';
import { WebcamServiceClient } from '@/services/generated-rpc-clients';

const client = new WebcamServiceClient(getRpcBaseUrl(), {
  fetch: (...args) => globalThis.fetch(...args),
});

const emptyResponse: ListWebcamsResponse = { webcams: [], clusters: [], totalInView: 0 };

// Client-side image cache (9 min, under Windy's 10-min token expiry)
const IMAGE_CACHE_MS = 9 * 60 * 1000;
const IMAGE_CACHE_MAX = 200;
const imageCacheMap = new Map<string, { data: GetWebcamImageResponse; expires: number }>();

export async function fetchWebcams(
  zoom: number,
  bounds: { w: number; s: number; e: number; n: number },
): Promise<ListWebcamsResponse> {
  try {
    return await client.listWebcams({
      zoom,
      boundW: bounds.w,
      boundS: bounds.s,
      boundE: bounds.e,
      boundN: bounds.n,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[webcams] fetch failed:', err);
    return emptyResponse;
  }
}

export async function fetchWebcamImage(webcamId: string): Promise<GetWebcamImageResponse> {
  // Check client cache
  const cached = imageCacheMap.get(webcamId);
  if (cached && cached.expires > Date.now()) return cached.data;

  try {
    const result = await client.getWebcamImage({ webcamId });
    if (!result.error) {
      if (imageCacheMap.size >= IMAGE_CACHE_MAX) {
        const oldest = imageCacheMap.keys().next().value;
        if (oldest) imageCacheMap.delete(oldest);
      }
      imageCacheMap.set(webcamId, { data: result, expires: Date.now() + IMAGE_CACHE_MS });
    }
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[webcams] image fetch failed:', err);
    return {
      thumbnailUrl: '', playerUrl: '', title: '',
      windyUrl: `https://www.windy.com/webcams/${webcamId}`,
      lastUpdated: '', error: 'unavailable',
    };
  }
}

// Category mapping for marker rendering
export const WEBCAM_CATEGORIES: Record<string, { color: string; emoji: string }> = {
  traffic:   { color: '#ffd700', emoji: '\u{1F697}' },    // ðŸš—
  city:      { color: '#00d4ff', emoji: '\u{1F3D9}\uFE0F' }, // ðŸ™ï¸
  landscape: { color: '#45b7d1', emoji: '\u{1F3D4}\uFE0F' }, // ðŸ”ï¸
  nature:    { color: '#96ceb4', emoji: '\u{1F33F}' },    // ðŸŒ¿
  beach:     { color: '#f4a460', emoji: '\u{1F3D6}\uFE0F' }, // ðŸ–ï¸
  water:     { color: '#4169e1', emoji: '\u{1F30A}' },    // ðŸŒŠ
  other:     { color: '#888888', emoji: '\u{1F4F7}' },    // ðŸ“·
};

export function getClusterCellSize(zoom: number): number {
  if (zoom < 3) return 8;
  if (zoom <= 4) return 5;
  if (zoom <= 6) return 2;
  if (zoom <= 8) return 0.5;
  return 0.5;
}

export function getCategoryStyle(category: string) {
  return WEBCAM_CATEGORIES[category] ?? WEBCAM_CATEGORIES.other!;
}

export type { WebcamEntry, WebcamCluster, GetWebcamImageResponse };

const STORAGE_KEY = 'wm-pinned-webcams';
const CHANGE_EVENT = 'wm-pinned-webcams-changed';
const MAX_ACTIVE = 4;

export interface PinnedWebcam {
  webcamId: string;
  title: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  category: string;
  country: string;
  playerUrl: string;
  active: boolean;
  pinnedAt: number;
}

let _cachedList: PinnedWebcam[] | null = null;
let _cacheFrame: number | null = null;

function load(): PinnedWebcam[] {
  if (_cachedList !== null) return _cachedList;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    _cachedList = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as PinnedWebcam[]) : [];
  } catch {
    _cachedList = [];
  }
  if (_cacheFrame === null) {
    _cacheFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { _cachedList = null; _cacheFrame = null; });
  }
  return _cachedList;
}

function showToast(msg: string): void {
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'wm-toast';
  el.textContent = msg;
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 3000);
}

function save(webcams: PinnedWebcam[]): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(webcams));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[pinned-webcams] localStorage save failed:', err);
    showToast('Could not save pinned webcams â€” storage full');
  }
  _cachedList = null;
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(CHANGE_EVENT));
}

export function getPinnedWebcams(): PinnedWebcam[] {
  return load();
}

export function getActiveWebcams(): PinnedWebcam[] {
  return load()
    .filter(w => w.active)
    .sort((a, b) => a.pinnedAt - b.pinnedAt)
    .slice(0, MAX_ACTIVE);
}

export function isPinned(webcamId: string): boolean {
  return load().some(w => w.webcamId === webcamId);
}

export function pinWebcam(webcam: Omit<PinnedWebcam, 'active' | 'pinnedAt'>): void {
  const list = load();
  if (list.some(w => w.webcamId === webcam.webcamId)) return;
  const activeCount = list.filter(w => w.active).length;
  list.push({
    ...webcam,
    active: activeCount < MAX_ACTIVE,
    pinnedAt: Date.now(),
  });
  save(list);
}

export function unpinWebcam(webcamId: string): void {
  const list = load().filter(w => w.webcamId !== webcamId);
  save(list);
}

export function toggleWebcam(webcamId: string): void {
  const list = load();
  const target = list.find(w => w.webcamId === webcamId);
  if (!target) return;
  if (!target.active) {
    const activeList = list
      .filter(w => w.active)
      .sort((a, b) => a.pinnedAt - b.pinnedAt);
    if (activeList.length >= MAX_ACTIVE && activeList[0]) {
      activeList[0].active = false;
    }
    target.active = true;
  } else {
    target.active = false;
  }
  save(list);
}

export function onPinnedChange(handler: () => void): () => void {
  const wrapped = () => handler();
  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, wrapped);
  return () => window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, wrapped);
}

  3313:     this.layers = { ...layers, dayNight: false };

   434:  * Existing consumers still narrow on `'count' in d`; `_kind` makes the

   441: interface BypassArcDatum {
   442:   source: [number, number];
   443:   target: [number, number];
   444: }
   445: 
   446: function interpolateGreatCircle(
   447:   start: [number, number],
   448:   end: [number, number],
   449:   numPoints: number,
   450: ): [number, number][] {
   451:   const toRad = (d: number) => d * Math.PI / 180;
   452:   const toDeg = (r: number) => r * 180 / Math.PI;
   453:   const [lon1, lat1] = [toRad(start[0]), toRad(start[1])];
   454:   const [lon2, lat2] = [toRad(end[0]), toRad(end[1])];
   455:   const d = 2 * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(
   456:     Math.sin((lat2 - lat1) / 2) ** 2 +
   457:     Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin((lon2 - lon1) / 2) ** 2,
   458:   ));
   459:   if (d < 1e-10) return [start, end];
   460:   const points: [number, number][] = [];
   461:   for (let i = 0; i <= numPoints; i++) {
   462:     const f = i / numPoints;
   463:     const A = Math.sin((1 - f) * d) / Math.sin(d);
   464:     const B = Math.sin(f * d) / Math.sin(d);
   465:     const x = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.cos(lon2);
   466:     const y = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.sin(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin(lon2);
   467:     const z = A * Math.sin(lat1) + B * Math.sin(lat2);
   468:     points.push([toDeg(Math.atan2(y, x)), toDeg(Math.atan2(z, Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)))]);
   469:   }
   470:   return points;
   471: }
   472: 
   473: function positionAlongPath(path: [number, number][], progress: number): [number, number] {
   474:   if (path.length === 0) return [0, 0];
   475:   if (path.length === 1) return path[0]!;
   476:   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
   477:   const scaled = clamped * (path.length - 1);
   478:   const index = Math.min(path.length - 2, Math.floor(scaled));
   479:   const fraction = scaled - index;
   480:   const [lonA, latA] = path[index]!;
   481:   const [lonB, latB] = path[index + 1]!;
   482:   // Unwrap longitude across the antimeridian so the lerp takes the short way:
   483:   // great-circle samples can straddle Â±180 (e.g. 176 â†’ -176), and a raw lerp
   484:   // would sweep the dot across the whole map to ~0Â°E for that segment (#4396).
   485:   let deltaLon = lonB - lonA;
   486:   if (deltaLon > 180) deltaLon -= 360;
   487:   else if (deltaLon < -180) deltaLon += 360;
   488:   let lon = lonA + deltaLon * fraction;
   489:   if (lon > 180) lon -= 360;
   490:   else if (lon < -180) lon += 360;
   491:   return [lon, latA + (latB - latA) * fraction];
   492: }
   493: 
   494: const PREFERS_REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY = '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)';
   495: const TRADE_ANIMATION_CYCLE = 1000;
   496: const TRADE_ANIMATION_SPEED = 0.3;
   497: const TRADE_ANIMATION_MAX_DELTA_MS = 100;
   498: const TRADE_GC_INTERPOLATION_POINTS = 20;
   499: const CHOKEPOINT_PULSE_FREQ = 0.01;
   500: const CHOKEPOINT_PULSE_AMP = 0.3;
   501: 
   502: function stableTradeRoutePhase(routeId: string): number {
   503:   let hash = 2166136261;
   504:   for (let i = 0; i < routeId.length; i++) {
   505:     const codeUnit = routeId.charCodeAt(i);
   506:     hash ^= codeUnit & 0xff;
   507:     hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
   508:     hash ^= (codeUnit >> 8) & 0xff;
   509:     hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
   510:   }
   511:   return ((hash >>> 0) / 0x100000000) * TRADE_ANIMATION_CYCLE;
   512: }

   473: function positionAlongPath(path: [number, number][], progress: number): [number, number] {
   474:   if (path.length === 0) return [0, 0];
   475:   if (path.length === 1) return path[0]!;
   476:   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
   477:   const scaled = clamped * (path.length - 1);
   478:   const index = Math.min(path.length - 2, Math.floor(scaled));
   479:   const fraction = scaled - index;
   480:   const [lonA, latA] = path[index]!;
   481:   const [lonB, latB] = path[index + 1]!;
   482:   // Unwrap longitude across the antimeridian so the lerp takes the short way:
   483:   // great-circle samples can straddle Â±180 (e.g. 176 â†’ -176), and a raw lerp
   484:   // would sweep the dot across the whole map to ~0Â°E for that segment (#4396).
   485:   let deltaLon = lonB - lonA;
   486:   if (deltaLon > 180) deltaLon -= 360;
   487:   else if (deltaLon < -180) deltaLon += 360;
   488:   let lon = lonA + deltaLon * fraction;
   489:   if (lon > 180) lon -= 360;

   446: function interpolateGreatCircle(
   447:   start: [number, number],
   448:   end: [number, number],
   449:   numPoints: number,
   450: ): [number, number][] {
   451:   const toRad = (d: number) => d * Math.PI / 180;
   452:   const toDeg = (r: number) => r * 180 / Math.PI;
   453:   const [lon1, lat1] = [toRad(start[0]), toRad(start[1])];
   454:   const [lon2, lat2] = [toRad(end[0]), toRad(end[1])];
   455:   const d = 2 * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(
   456:     Math.sin((lat2 - lat1) / 2) ** 2 +
   457:     Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin((lon2 - lon1) / 2) ** 2,
   458:   ));
   459:   if (d < 1e-10) return [start, end];
   460:   const points: [number, number][] = [];
   461:   for (let i = 0; i <= numPoints; i++) {
   462:     const f = i / numPoints;
   463:     const A = Math.sin((1 - f) * d) / Math.sin(d);
   464:     const B = Math.sin(f * d) / Math.sin(d);
   465:     const x = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.cos(lon2);
   466:     const y = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.sin(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin(lon2);
   467:     const z = A * Math.sin(lat1) + B * Math.sin(lat2);
   468:     points.push([toDeg(Math.atan2(y, x)), toDeg(Math.atan2(z, Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)))]);
   469:   }
   470:   return points;
   471: }
   472: 
   473: function positionAlongPath(path: [number, number][], progress: number): [number, number] {
   474:   if (path.length === 0) return [0, 0];
   475:   if (path.length === 1) return path[0]!;
   476:   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
   477:   const scaled = clamped * (path.length - 1);
   478:   const index = Math.min(path.length - 2, Math.floor(scaled));
   479:   const fraction = scaled - index;
   480:   const [lonA, latA] = path[index]!;
   481:   const [lonB, latB] = path[index + 1]!;
   482:   // Unwrap longitude across the antimeridian so the lerp takes the short way:
   483:   // great-circle samples can straddle Â±180 (e.g. 176 â†’ -176), and a raw lerp
   484:   // would sweep the dot across the whole map to ~0Â°E for that segment (#4396).
   485:   let deltaLon = lonB - lonA;
   486:   if (deltaLon > 180) deltaLon -= 360;
   487:   else if (deltaLon < -180) deltaLon += 360;
   488:   let lon = lonA + deltaLon * fraction;
   489:   if (lon > 180) lon -= 360;
   490:   else if (lon < -180) lon += 360;
   491:   return [lon, latA + (latB - latA) * fraction];
   492: }

  6384:   // Utility methods
  6385:   private hexToRgba(hex: string, alpha: number): [number, number, number, number] {
  6386:     const result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
  6387:     if (result?.[1] && result[2] && result[3]) {
  6388:       return [
  6389:         parseInt(result[1], 16),
  6390:         parseInt(result[2], 16),
  6391:         parseInt(result[3], 16),
  6392:         alpha,
  6393:       ];
  6394:     }
  6395:     return [100, 100, 100, alpha];
  6396:   }

  6320:     this.container.querySelector('.deckgl-webcam-popup')?.remove();
  6321: 
  6322:     const popup = document.createElement('div');
  6323:     popup.className = 'deckgl-webcam-popup';
  6324:     popup.style.position = 'absolute';
  6325:     popup.style.left = x + 'px';
  6326:     popup.style.top = y + 'px';
  6327:     popup.style.zIndex = '1000';
  6328: 
  6329:     const titleEl = document.createElement('div');
  6330:     titleEl.className = 'deckgl-webcam-popup-title';
  6331:     titleEl.textContent = webcam.title || webcam.webcamId || '';
  6332:     popup.appendChild(titleEl);
  6333: 
  6334:     const locationEl = document.createElement('div');
  6335:     locationEl.className = 'deckgl-webcam-popup-location';
  6336:     locationEl.textContent = webcam.country || '';
  6337:     popup.appendChild(locationEl);
  6338: 
  6339:     const id = webcam.webcamId;
  6340: 
  6341:     // Fetch playerUrl for when user pins
  6342:     const imageData = await fetchWebcamImage(id).catch(() => null);
  6343: 
  6344:     const pinBtn = document.createElement('button');
  6345:     pinBtn.className = 'webcam-pin-btn';
  6346:     if (isPinned(id)) {
  6347:       pinBtn.classList.add('webcam-pin-btn--pinned');
  6348:       pinBtn.textContent = '\u{1F4CC} Pinned';
  6349:       pinBtn.disabled = true;
  6350:     } else {
  6351:       pinBtn.textContent = '\u{1F4CC} Pin';
  6352:       pinBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  6353:         e.stopPropagation();
  6354:         pinWebcam({
  6355:           webcamId: id,
  6356:           title: webcam.title || imageData?.title || '',
  6357:           lat: webcam.lat,
  6358:           lng: webcam.lng,
  6359:           category: webcam.category || 'other',
  6360:           country: webcam.country || '',
  6361:           playerUrl: imageData?.playerUrl || '',
  6362:         });
  6363:         pinBtn.classList.add('webcam-pin-btn--pinned');
  6364:         pinBtn.textContent = '\u{1F4CC} Pinned';
  6365:         pinBtn.disabled = true;
  6366:       });
  6367:     }
  6368:     popup.appendChild(pinBtn);
  6369: 
  6370:     const cleanup = () => {
  6371:       popup.remove();
  6372:       document.removeEventListener('click', closeHandler);
  6373:       clearTimeout(autoDismiss);
  6374:     };
  6375:     const closeHandler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
  6376:       if (!popup.contains(e.target as Node)) cleanup();
  6377:     };
  6378:     const autoDismiss = setTimeout(cleanup, 8000);
  6379:     setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener('click', closeHandler), 0);
  6380: 
  6381:     this.container.appendChild(popup);
  6382:   }
  6383: 
  6384:   // Utility methods
  6385:   private hexToRgba(hex: string, alpha: number): [number, number, number, number] {
  6386:     const result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
  6387:     if (result?.[1] && result[2] && result[3]) {
  6388:       return [
  6389:         parseInt(result[1], 16),
  6390:         parseInt(result[2], 16),
  6391:         parseInt(result[3], 16),
  6392:         alpha,
  6393:       ];
  6394:     }
  6395:     return [100, 100, 100, alpha];
  6396:   }

  6403:       <div class="zoom-controls">
  6404:         <button class="map-btn zoom-in" title="${t('components.deckgl.zoomIn')}" aria-label="${t('components.deckgl.zoomIn')}">+</button>
  6405:         <button class="map-btn zoom-out" title="${t('components.deckgl.zoomOut')}" aria-label="${t('components.deckgl.zoomOut')}">-</button>

  6407:       </div>
  6408:       <div class="view-selector">
  6409:         <select class="view-select" aria-label="${t('header.selectRegion')}">
  6410:           <option value="global">${t('components.deckgl.views.global')}</option>
  6411:           <option value="america">${t('components.deckgl.views.americas')}</option>
  6412:           <option value="mena">${t('components.deckgl.views.mena')}</option>

  6414:           <option value="asia">${t('components.deckgl.views.asia')}</option>
  6415:           <option value="latam">${t('components.deckgl.views.latam')}</option>
  6416:           <option value="africa">${t('components.deckgl.views.africa')}</option>
  6417:           <option value="oceania">${t('components.deckgl.views.oceania')}</option>
  6418:         </select>
  6419:       </div>
  6420:     `, "legacy direct innerHTML migration"));
  6421: 
  6422:     this.container.appendChild(controls);
  6423: 
  6424:     // Bind events - use event delegation for reliability
  6425:     controls.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  6426:       const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
  6427:       if (target.classList.contains('zoom-in')) this.zoomIn();
  6428:       else if (target.classList.contains('zoom-out')) this.zoomOut();
  6429:       else if (target.classList.contains('zoom-reset')) this.resetView();

  8001:   public async setGpsJamming(hexes: GpsJamHex[]): Promise<void> {
  8002:     const seq = ++this.gpsJammingLoadSeq;
  8003:     if (hexes.length === 0) {
  8004:       this.gpsJammingHexes = [];
  8005:       this.render();
  8006:       return;
  8007:     }
  8008: 
  8009:     try {
  8010:       const { cellToBoundary } = await import('h3-js');
  8011:       if (seq !== this.gpsJammingLoadSeq) return;
  8012:       // Precompute each hex boundary once per data refresh (every ~5 min)
  8013:       // instead of calling cellToBoundary per hex on every buildLayers()/render.
  8014:       this.gpsJammingHexes = hexes.map(h => ({
  8015:         ...h,
  8016:         polygon: cellToBoundary(h.h3, true) as [number, number][],
  8017:       }));
  8018:       this.render();
  8019:     } catch (err) {
  8020:       if (seq !== this.gpsJammingLoadSeq) return;
  8021:       this.gpsJammingHexes = [];
  8022:       this.render();
  8023:       console.warn('[DeckGLMap] failed to prepare GPS jamming polygons:', (err as Error)?.message);
  8024:       throw err;
  8025:     }
  8026:   }

  8042:     }
  8043:     this.newsLocations = data;
  8044:     this.render();
  8045: 
  8046:     this.syncPulseAnimation(now);
  8047:   }

  8001:   public async setGpsJamming(hexes: GpsJamHex[]): Promise<void> {
  8002:     const seq = ++this.gpsJammingLoadSeq;
  8003:     if (hexes.length === 0) {
  8004:       this.gpsJammingHexes = [];
  8005:       this.render();
  8006:       return;
  8007:     }
  8008: 
  8009:     try {
  8010:       const { cellToBoundary } = await import('h3-js');
  8011:       if (seq !== this.gpsJammingLoadSeq) return;
  8012:       // Precompute each hex boundary once per data refresh (every ~5 min)
  8013:       // instead of calling cellToBoundary per hex on every buildLayers()/render.
  8014:       this.gpsJammingHexes = hexes.map(h => ({
  8015:         ...h,
  8016:         polygon: cellToBoundary(h.h3, true) as [number, number][],
  8017:       }));
  8018:       this.render();
  8019:     } catch (err) {
  8020:       if (seq !== this.gpsJammingLoadSeq) return;
  8021:       this.gpsJammingHexes = [];
  8022:       this.render();
  8023:       console.warn('[DeckGLMap] failed to prepare GPS jamming polygons:', (err as Error)?.message);
  8024:       throw err;
  8025:     }
  8026:   }

   406: function ensureClosedRing(ring: [number, number][]): [number, number][] {
   407:   if (ring.length < 2) return ring;
   408:   const first = ring[0]!;
   409:   const last = ring[ring.length - 1]!;
   410:   if (first[0] === last[0] && first[1] === last[1]) return ring;

   446: function interpolateGreatCircle(
   447:   start: [number, number],
   448:   end: [number, number],
   449:   numPoints: number,
   450: ): [number, number][] {
   451:   const toRad = (d: number) => d * Math.PI / 180;
   452:   const toDeg = (r: number) => r * 180 / Math.PI;
   453:   const [lon1, lat1] = [toRad(start[0]), toRad(start[1])];
   454:   const [lon2, lat2] = [toRad(end[0]), toRad(end[1])];
   455:   const d = 2 * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(
   456:     Math.sin((lat2 - lat1) / 2) ** 2 +
   457:     Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin((lon2 - lon1) / 2) ** 2,
   458:   ));
   459:   if (d < 1e-10) return [start, end];
   460:   const points: [number, number][] = [];
   461:   for (let i = 0; i <= numPoints; i++) {
   462:     const f = i / numPoints;
   463:     const A = Math.sin((1 - f) * d) / Math.sin(d);
   464:     const B = Math.sin(f * d) / Math.sin(d);
   465:     const x = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.cos(lon2);
   466:     const y = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.sin(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin(lon2);
   467:     const z = A * Math.sin(lat1) + B * Math.sin(lat2);
   468:     points.push([toDeg(Math.atan2(y, x)), toDeg(Math.atan2(z, Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)))]);
   469:   }
   470:   return points;
   471: }
   472: 
   473: function positionAlongPath(path: [number, number][], progress: number): [number, number] {
   474:   if (path.length === 0) return [0, 0];
   475:   if (path.length === 1) return path[0]!;
   476:   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
   477:   const scaled = clamped * (path.length - 1);
   478:   const index = Math.min(path.length - 2, Math.floor(scaled));
   479:   const fraction = scaled - index;
   480:   const [lonA, latA] = path[index]!;
   481:   const [lonB, latB] = path[index + 1]!;
   482:   // Unwrap longitude across the antimeridian so the lerp takes the short way:
   483:   // great-circle samples can straddle Â±180 (e.g. 176 â†’ -176), and a raw lerp
   484:   // would sweep the dot across the whole map to ~0Â°E for that segment (#4396).
   485:   let deltaLon = lonB - lonA;
   486:   if (deltaLon > 180) deltaLon -= 360;
   487:   else if (deltaLon < -180) deltaLon += 360;
   488:   let lon = lonA + deltaLon * fraction;
   489:   if (lon > 180) lon -= 360;
   490:   else if (lon < -180) lon += 360;
   491:   return [lon, latA + (latB - latA) * fraction];
   492: }

   442:   source: [number, number];

   446: function interpolateGreatCircle(
   447:   start: [number, number],
   448:   end: [number, number],
   449:   numPoints: number,
   450: ): [number, number][] {
   451:   const toRad = (d: number) => d * Math.PI / 180;
   452:   const toDeg = (r: number) => r * 180 / Math.PI;
   453:   const [lon1, lat1] = [toRad(start[0]), toRad(start[1])];
   454:   const [lon2, lat2] = [toRad(end[0]), toRad(end[1])];
   455:   const d = 2 * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(
   456:     Math.sin((lat2 - lat1) / 2) ** 2 +
   457:     Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin((lon2 - lon1) / 2) ** 2,
   458:   ));
   459:   if (d < 1e-10) return [start, end];
   460:   const points: [number, number][] = [];
   461:   for (let i = 0; i <= numPoints; i++) {
   462:     const f = i / numPoints;
   463:     const A = Math.sin((1 - f) * d) / Math.sin(d);
   464:     const B = Math.sin(f * d) / Math.sin(d);
   465:     const x = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.cos(lon2);
   466:     const y = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.sin(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin(lon2);
   467:     const z = A * Math.sin(lat1) + B * Math.sin(lat2);
   468:     points.push([toDeg(Math.atan2(y, x)), toDeg(Math.atan2(z, Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)))]);
   469:   }
   470:   return points;
   471: }
   472: 
   473: function positionAlongPath(path: [number, number][], progress: number): [number, number] {
   474:   if (path.length === 0) return [0, 0];
   475:   if (path.length === 1) return path[0]!;
   476:   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
   477:   const scaled = clamped * (path.length - 1);
   478:   const index = Math.min(path.length - 2, Math.floor(scaled));
   479:   const fraction = scaled - index;
   480:   const [lonA, latA] = path[index]!;
   481:   const [lonB, latB] = path[index + 1]!;
   482:   // Unwrap longitude across the antimeridian so the lerp takes the short way:
   483:   // great-circle samples can straddle Â±180 (e.g. 176 â†’ -176), and a raw lerp
   484:   // would sweep the dot across the whole map to ~0Â°E for that segment (#4396).
   485:   let deltaLon = lonB - lonA;
   486:   if (deltaLon > 180) deltaLon -= 360;
   487:   else if (deltaLon < -180) deltaLon += 360;
   488:   let lon = lonA + deltaLon * fraction;
   489:   if (lon > 180) lon -= 360;
   490:   else if (lon < -180) lon += 360;
   491:   return [lon, latA + (latB - latA) * fraction];
   492: }
   493: 
   494: const PREFERS_REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY = '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)';
   495: const TRADE_ANIMATION_CYCLE = 1000;
   496: const TRADE_ANIMATION_SPEED = 0.3;
   497: const TRADE_ANIMATION_MAX_DELTA_MS = 100;
   498: const TRADE_GC_INTERPOLATION_POINTS = 20;
   499: const CHOKEPOINT_PULSE_FREQ = 0.01;
   500: const CHOKEPOINT_PULSE_AMP = 0.3;

   467:     const z = A * Math.sin(lat1) + B * Math.sin(lat2);
   468:     points.push([toDeg(Math.atan2(y, x)), toDeg(Math.atan2(z, Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)))]);
   469:   }
   470:   return points;
   471: }
   472: 
   473: function positionAlongPath(path: [number, number][], progress: number): [number, number] {
   474:   if (path.length === 0) return [0, 0];
   475:   if (path.length === 1) return path[0]!;
   476:   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
   477:   const scaled = clamped * (path.length - 1);
   478:   const index = Math.min(path.length - 2, Math.floor(scaled));
   479:   const fraction = scaled - index;
   480:   const [lonA, latA] = path[index]!;
   481:   const [lonB, latB] = path[index + 1]!;
   482:   // Unwrap longitude across the antimeridian so the lerp takes the short way:
   483:   // great-circle samples can straddle Â±180 (e.g. 176 â†’ -176), and a raw lerp
   484:   // would sweep the dot across the whole map to ~0Â°E for that segment (#4396).
   485:   let deltaLon = lonB - lonA;
   486:   if (deltaLon > 180) deltaLon -= 360;
   487:   else if (deltaLon < -180) deltaLon += 360;
   488:   let lon = lonA + deltaLon * fraction;
   489:   if (lon > 180) lon -= 360;
   490:   else if (lon < -180) lon += 360;
   491:   return [lon, latA + (latB - latA) * fraction];
   492: }
   493: 
   494: const PREFERS_REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY = '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)';
   495: const TRADE_ANIMATION_CYCLE = 1000;
   496: const TRADE_ANIMATION_SPEED = 0.3;
   497: const TRADE_ANIMATION_MAX_DELTA_MS = 100;
   498: const TRADE_GC_INTERPOLATION_POINTS = 20;
   499: const CHOKEPOINT_PULSE_FREQ = 0.01;
   500: const CHOKEPOINT_PULSE_AMP = 0.3;
   501: 
   502: function stableTradeRoutePhase(routeId: string): number {
   503:   let hash = 2166136261;
   504:   for (let i = 0; i < routeId.length; i++) {
   505:     const codeUnit = routeId.charCodeAt(i);
   506:     hash ^= codeUnit & 0xff;
   507:     hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
   508:     hash ^= (codeUnit >> 8) & 0xff;
   509:     hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
   510:   }
   511:   return ((hash >>> 0) / 0x100000000) * TRADE_ANIMATION_CYCLE;
   512: }

  3131:     if (mapLayers.ciiChoropleth) {
  3132:       const ciiLayer = this.createCIIChoroplethLayer();
  3133:       if (ciiLayer) layers.push(ciiLayer);
  3134:     }
  3135:     if (mapLayers.resilienceScore) {

  3146:     if (scenarioHeat) layers.push(scenarioHeat);

  3159:

  3168:         radiusUnits: 'pixels',
  3169:         pickable: true,
  3170:       }));
  3171:     }
  3172:

  3176:     }
  3177:

  5986:   private handleClick(info: PickingInfo): void {
  5987:     this.activeCyberThreatForAnalysis = null;
  5988:     this.activeAviationForAnalysis = null;
  5989:     this.activeMaritimeForAnalysis = null;
  5990:     const isChoropleth = info.layer?.id ? DeckGLMap.CHOROPLETH_LAYER_IDS.has(info.layer.id) : false;
  5991:     if (!info.object || isChoropleth) {
  5992:       if (info.coordinate && this.onCountryClick) {
  5993:         if (this.shouldSuppressCountryClickAfterDrag()) return;
  5994:         const [lon, lat] = info.coordinate as [number, number];
  5995:         let country: { code: string; name: string } | null = null;
  5996:         if (isChoropleth && info.object?.properties) {
  5997:           country = { code: info.object.properties['ISO3166-1-Alpha-2'] as string, name: info.object.properties.name as string };
  5998:         } else {
  5999:           country = resolveCountryForPointerInteraction(
  6000:             { code: this.hoveredCountryIso2, name: this.hoveredCountryName },
  6001:             this.hoverQueryThrottle?.isPending() ?? false,
  6002:             () => this.resolveCountryFromCoordinate(lon, lat),
  6003:           );
  6004:         }

  8001:   public async setGpsJamming(hexes: GpsJamHex[]): Promise<void> {
  8002:     const seq = ++this.gpsJammingLoadSeq;
  8003:     if (hexes.length === 0) {
  8004:       this.gpsJammingHexes = [];
  8005:       this.render();
  8006:       return;
  8007:     }
  8008: 
  8009:     try {
  8010:       const { cellToBoundary } = await import('h3-js');
  8011:       if (seq !== this.gpsJammingLoadSeq) return;
  8012:       // Precompute each hex boundary once per data refresh (every ~5 min)
  8013:       // instead of calling cellToBoundary per hex on every buildLayers()/render.
  8014:       this.gpsJammingHexes = hexes.map(h => ({
  8015:         ...h,
  8016:         polygon: cellToBoundary(h.h3, true) as [number, number][],
  8017:       }));
  8018:       this.render();
  8019:     } catch (err) {
  8020:       if (seq !== this.gpsJammingLoadSeq) return;
  8021:       this.gpsJammingHexes = [];
  8022:       this.render();
  8023:       console.warn('[DeckGLMap] failed to prepare GPS jamming polygons:', (err as Error)?.message);
  8024:       throw err;
  8025:     }
  8026:   }
